description:
Unofficial desktop widget for Home Assistant: control devices, view sensors and pin entities to your desktop.

HA Desktop Widget is a free, open-source desktop app for Home Assistant. It shows your favorite entities in a frosted-glass panel with live WebSocket updates, lets you toggle lights and switches, watch cameras, compare sensors on a 24-hour graph, pin tiles to the desktop and control devices with global hotkeys. Sign-in happens on Home Assistant's own page. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with the Open Home Foundation.
